FN-YSDW226-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 31
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator J.T. Waggoner
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/26/2024
Senate Bill 31 as introduced would change the administrator of the Distressed Institutions of
Higher Education Revolving Loan Program from the State Treasurer to the Executive Director
of the Alabama Commission on Higher Education (ACHE) and reallocate any monies
appropriated to the Distressed Institutions of Higher Education Loan Program Fund (Fund) to
ACHE to be used for the program. This will increase the administrative obligations of the
Executive Director of ACHE and will decrease the administrative obligations of the State
Treasurer. Additionally, the increased obligations to ACHE would be paid from the Fund. This
bill clarifies that any interest earned or any contributions from other sources to the Fund at the
end of a fiscal year shall remain in the Fund.

FN-YSDW226-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 31
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator J.T. Waggoner
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/18/2024
Senate Bill 31 as passed the Senate would increase the administrative obligations of the
Executive Director of the Alabama Commission on Higher Education (ACHE) and would
correspondingly decrease the administrative obligations of the State Treasurer by changing the
administrator of the Distressed Institutions of Higher Education Revolving Loan Program from
the State Treasurer, under current law, to the Executive Director of ACHE.
This bill would also reallocate any monies appropriated to the Distressed Institutions of Higher
Education Loan Program Fund (Fund) to ACHE to be used for the program and provide that any
interest earned by the Fund, or any contributions from other sources to the Fund, would not
revert at the end of a fiscal year.
This bill would also provide further for the terms and conditions under which a loan may be
issued by the program.
